info.name: Spring Boot Sample Project
info.description:
Postman collection for the Spring Boot Sample Project.

Collection variables:
- base_url: server base (default http://localhost:8080)
- context_path: app context path (default sample_project)

Each module is a single folder of requests matching controller mappings.
Optional Tenant-Id header is present on every request but disabled by default.

request.description: Path uses get_commited_offset (typo in controller mapping).
secret_key is optional; falls back to CRYPTOGRAPHY_SECRET_KEY. If provided for DES, must be exactly 8 bytes.
